description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for SEC NPORT holdings disclosures, including query parameters, data parsing, and transformation logic.

classes.name: SecNportDisclosureQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for SEC NPORT holdings requests, including cache usage.

classes.name: SecNportDisclosureData
classes.description: Represents the SEC NPORT holdings data with various optional fields for detailed security info.

classes.name: SecNportDisclosureFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming SEC NPORT disclosure data from SEC endpoints.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SecNportDisclosureQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw SEC NPORT data, handling caching, retries, and XML parsing.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw XML data into structured, validated SEC NPORT disclosure data, extracting nested details and metadata.
